segments.text: At the research institute KOKON, he is in charge of the development of combat androids "EXTRAs", as well as being their guardian.
Despite young age, he has a talent for genetic engineering that stands out among the researchers.
He is an outwardly bright and intellectual person, but harbors various doubts and internal conflicts. He tries to treat the three EXTRAs under his care like family.

She is in charge of another EXTRA development laboratory, that advocates a different approach from Tsunakawa's. She has a strong rivalry with Tsunakawa due to her high pride and different values.
津名川と同様に古痕で『エクストラ』の研究を行っている女性。
津名川とはライバル関係にある。
人工の「神」をつくりたい という理想を持っている。

Head of the Intelligence Department of KOKON. She is an intelligent and motherly woman who has risen to the position of Graham's right-hand at a young age. She was once in a relationship with Tsunakawa, but they are now friends, perhaps because she hates to be restrained by others.
若くして古痕の頭脳とも言える情報部部長を務める才媛。
個人主義で、人に束縛されることを嫌うタイプ。
過去に 津名川と交際していたが、現在はなんとなく距離をおいている。

終わりの日を考えて生きれば、痛いほど今の大事さがわかるの……」
He is an old man who is the founder of KOKON. While he is leading an organization that is willing to conduct inhumane research, he himself is a good person.
He has the power to see “something” in others that ordinary people cannot see, and in order to find out the meaning of this power, he gathered those who have that “something” and created the KOKON.
予言的で人の心を見透かしたような発言をするカリスマ的人物。
『古痕』の創設者として、組織内に暗然とした影響力を持っている。

「“経験に勝る信仰なし”と言うやつだ」
He used to be a researcher at KOKON, but left due to a disagreement with Graham. He is now an agent for the National Public Safety Commission, and is currently investigating KOKON's activities.
He is a fighter of inhuman strength, and acts only on the basis of his own convictions.

国家公安委員会のナンバーレス・エージェント。
自らに肉体改造を施して、 比類なき強さを誇っている。

segments.text: One of the protagonist's pupils. She is confident and determined, and to make matters worse, she is rash. However, deep down she is obedient and hard-working. She is a little too self-conscious and often compares herself to others. She likes sweets and cute Western clothing.
Based on the official site
主人公の弟子。
大貴族ヴァンクリフ家の次女。兄２人と姉が一人いる。
親に勝手に決められた婚約が嫌で家出し、魔法院に入った。
ちょっと勝気で、自信家。無鉄砲。根は素直で努力する性格。
好きなものは甘いお菓子とかわいいお洋服＆お着替え。家事は下手。
多少自意識過剰で、他人と自分を比べて凹むところがある。
One of the protagonist's pupils. A simple and serious girl. She is very sensitive and will be deeply moved by little things. She likes naps, stories, and taking baths.
Based on the official site
主人公の弟子。
典型的な巻き込まれ型ヒロイン。
閉鎖的な少数民族ロシタリ出身。
純血を重んじる一族の中で、混血児だったために村を追われた。
魔法の血の濃いロシタリだったということで魔法院に迎えられたが、
都会的な魔法院にはなじめなかったようだ。
質素で、朴訥で、真面目な女の子。小さなことに感動する。
好きなのは昼寝、お話、あとお風呂。
主人公の弟子。閉鎖的な少数民族ロシタリ出身。純血を重んじる一族の中で、混血児だったために村を追われることに。母親と死別し、自身も衰弱していたところを魔法院の関係者に発見される。魔法院に迎えられて、ロシタリ語の辞書の編纂に携わるが、多くの人間に囲まれた活動や、都会的な魔法院での生活にはなじめないようだ。
質素で素朴、そして真面目な女の子。小さなことに感動できる感受性の豊かさを持つ。好きなことは昼寝、お話、あとはお風呂に入ること。
The emperor's only daughter. Because she can't sense people's ill will, she is friendly to everyone. Since she is a princess, her way of thinking is considerably different than normal people's.
Based on the official site
現皇帝の一人娘。「花のフィアンナ姫」と呼ばれ、慕われている。
天然系。他人の悪意を感じ取れないので、何事も好意的に受け取ってしまう。
皇女ゆえ、一般人とは考え方や感じ方がかなり違っている。
いつでも躁状態。超前向き。不快という状況がわからない。
世の中で一番頭を使うことは、午後のお茶の選択。２番目は文化振興策。
他は何も考えていない。
Fianna's maid. She has cat ears and a tail. Her special talent is making tea. She was going to be a slave in the emperor's harem, but she caught Fianna's eye and was made to be her maid.
Based on the official site
フィアンナ姫お付きのメイド。
ねこ耳、ねこしっぽを持つシャオ族出身。
耳は頭の上の２つのみ。ぴくぴく動く。
特技はお茶を淹れること。
皇帝のハーレムに献上される奴隷だったが、
フィアンナ姫の目にとまり、そのままお付きのメイドに。

actors.name: あおきさやか(青木静香)

segments.text: A unique woman who was a gladiator. She was so overwhelmingly popular that she won her freedom from slavery. Now, she is a bounty hunter.
Based on the official site
異色の女性剣闘士として、奴隷出身ながら圧倒的人気を誇り、自由を勝ち得た。
「魔嬢オリヴィア」は剣闘士時代のニックネーム。
６匹の猟犬を自在に操り、無敗の伝説を残した。
現在は賞金稼ぎを生業にしている。
激しい気性。プライドが高い。サディスティック。

A woman able to perform healing miracles since she was a child. She was awarded the title of "Healing Saint" by the Vatican. The Vatican deeply trusts her and people love her. She is a simple, serious, and kind Onee-san type.
Based on the official site
幼い頃から"癒し"の奇蹟が使えたため、
法王庁から正式に"癒しの聖女"の称号を授けられている。
聖女は世界に何人もいない存在で、
ゆえに法王庁の多大な信頼を受け、また民衆から慕われている。
真面目な人。質素で、素朴で、優しいお姉さん。
何かあるたびにお祈りを欠かさない。
封印が解かれた「黒の塔」の存在を重く見た法王庁から、
調査の依頼を受けてやってくる。

cast.characterName: マリエラ・グランバック
cast.originalCharacterName: マリエラ・グランバック

segments.text: A famous architect. She likes beautiful buildings and finds them irresistible. She is a perfectionist who will never compromise. She fell in love with the Black Tower, so she decided to live in it.
Based on the official site
有名な建築家。しかし悪い噂も多い。天才ゆえにねたまれている。
美しい建築物が好きでたまらない。
衣食住全てにこだわりを持つ。妥協を許さない完璧主義者。
詩的表現を好んで使うので、芝居がかって見える。
古代から立つ遺跡などの建築物の調査もしている。
黒の塔の建築物としての素晴らしさに惚れて、そのまま住み込んでしまう。
塔の増築、改装をしてくれる。

An adventurer's companion. She is good at taking care of people. Her manners are good as well. But she has a habit of telling lies by exaggerating everything. When she is troubled she digs a hole and buries herself.
Based on the official site
美人でいかにもエルフの神秘的な外見をしているのに嘘つき。
面倒見はいい。人当たりもよい。でも嘘をつく。
おまけにその嘘を維持するために一緒に行動までしてくれる。
ある意味では自分で穴を掘ってそこに埋まりに行く感じ。
物事は常に大げさに言う。1匹いれば100匹になる理論。
オオトカゲがドラゴンになったりする。
エルフに伝わる魔法と占いが得意。
二年目に塔に遊びにやってくる。一年間だけ塔に滞在し、
ヒロインたちに魔法を教えてくれる。

The ruler of sprites that is living in the world of humans. She is super powerful and has the ability to make magic tools. Her personality is nonsensical. She is abnormally forgetful and the type that is unable to read the situation.
Based on the official site
人間界に住む元妖精王。
人間の男性と交わってしまったため、妖精界に帰れなくなってしまった。
超強力な魔法の道具を生み出す能力がある。
性格滅茶苦茶。王冠コレクター。
波乱万丈の人生こそ人間の幸せと思い込んでいる。歴史に干渉しまくり。
異常に忘れっぽく、話が通じない。空気を読まないタイプ。
An angel. Although she is of the lower-class, her magic power is huge.
Based on the official site
かつて黒の塔で召還された天使。
天使の中では最下層に位置するが、それでも膨大な魔力を持っている。
自分で考えるということをしないため、誰の言うことでもすぐに聞いてしまう。
それだけに、非常にはた迷惑な存在。

She is the head of the mechanical development office at KOKON and in charge of developing weapons for EXTRAs. She is a weapons enthusiast and lover of beautiful girls, especially Touka, so she is unusually cooperative with Tsunakawa.
A junior high school genius with an IQ of 200 who works as Takamiya's assistant.
She is a test-tube baby created by KOKON experiment, by mixing superior genes, and as is customary, she takes Kirita as a surname (derived from KOKON's official name “Kirita Pharmaceuticals”).

Chika is one of the identical twin "EXTRA" androids which were created by Ellen. Both she and and her sister Chito do not have any human feelings, they are designed to be used only as cold-blooded weapons. The two of them were created from Atsuko's genes.
It seems that the only difference between the twins is their hairstyles. While Chika has two braids, Chito has only one.

Chito is one of the identical twin "EXTRA" androids which were created by Ellen. Both she and and her sister Chika do not have any human feelings, they are designed to be used only as cold-blooded weapons. The two of them were created from Atsuko's genes.
It seems that the only difference between the twins is their hairstyles. While Chika has two braids, Chito has only one.

The player character and second violin of the string quartet. Despite lacking formal training and practical knowledge of classical music, Phill is incredibly gifted in playing the violin. He was discovered by a professor of Magnolia Music Institute by sheer chance, and upon that, coerced into joining the orchestra. Phill is a cheerful and charismatic individual who always seems to have the best answers when facing adversity. Ultimately he becomes the emotional cornerstone upon which the quartet relies: their one certainty in chaos.
From an old review by Nargrakhan

cast.originalCharacterName: シャルロット・フランシア

segments.text: First violin and leader of the string quartet. Since she could walk, Charlotte has been educated in playing the violin. She is incredibly skilled, regularly winning competitions and impressing instrumentalists around the world. Charlotte is rather sensitive about her height, and doesn’t handle romantic emotions very well.
From an old review by Nargrakhan

Viola of the string quartet. Juni was born and raised in Italy with her twin sister, Mai. She original was a violinist, but a situation occurred that led her into perfecting the viola; one that only she and her sister know the reasons of. Because of her bright personality and quick humor, Juni is frequently the mood maker of the quartet.
From an old review by Nargrakhan

Cello of the string quartet. Li is a quiet and socially withdrawn individual, preferring the role of an observer whenever the situation allows. She has an unusual view with men due to repeating negative experiences.
From an old review by Nargrakhan

Phill’s younger sister. Despite her youth, Lina is an exceptionally intelligent girl. She loves her brother, but tends to view him in a negative light due to his frequent unreliability. Not afraid to speak her mind.
From an old review by Nargrakhan

Juni’s twin sister and first violin of the rival quartet. Cheerful and energetic, she is a protégée of unequalled potential, widely considered the greatest student the Institute has ever produced. Deeply loyal to her sister; more so than most believe.
From an old review by Nargrakhan

Second violin of the rival quartet. Hans is a close friend of Phill and an outstanding student. Generally a rather plain and mundane individual - some would even say a nerd - but his passion for classical music can only be described as fanatical.
From an old review by Nargrakhan

segments.text: Cello of the rival quartet. Gizelle is heiress of the wealthy and noble Stolzenberg bloodline. Gizelle’s overwhelming pride tends to unintentionally drag her into troublesome situations… big trouble.
From an old review by Nargrakhan

segments.text: Viola and leader of the rival quartet. Signina is a barmaid who commutes to Magnolia Music Academy. She has a no nonsense personality, and is the kind of person who openly reveals her feelings and opinions.
From an old review by Nargrakhan
